control_description: MFA enforced on all accounts with access to ePHI; role-based access controls implemented
EDR deployed on all endpoints; daily backups with offline copy
DLP policies active on email and USB; quarterly access reviews
Monthly vulnerability scans with Qualys; 30-day patching SLA for critical findings
Security awareness training quarterly; email filtering with anti-phishing rules
Annual vendor risk assessments; BAA in place; contractual security requirements
Quarterly access reviews; least privilege policy enforced; Azure AD PIM
Full disk encryption on all devices; remote wipe capability via MDM
WAF deployed; DDoS mitigation through cloud provider
Annual FERPA training; access limited to need-to-know; audit logging enabled
Automated provisioning/deprovisioning via HR sync; quarterly orphan account audits
Splunk deployed with 90-day retention; alerting rules for critical events
Identity verification procedures for password resets; help desk security training
